contenders.sillon: @sillon/react parts over streamPeaks(): fetch-streamed MP3, WebCodecs decode in a worker, 256-sample max-abs peaks; plus a preload=metadata <audio> as usePlayer creates.
contenders.sillon-fallback: sillon with its worker forced to report unsupported: whole-file fetch + OfflineAudioContext.decodeAudioData at 44.1 kHz, peaks on the main thread.
contenders.ws: wavesurfer.js 8.0.2 defaults (url only): fetch + decodeAudioData into an 8 kHz AudioContext.
contenders.ws-peaks: wavesurfer.js 8.0.2 with precomputed 8000-point peaks JSON + duration (its long-file advice); JSON fetch timed, server step in serverPeaksCost.
contenders.naive: fetch + new AudioContext().decodeAudioData + per-pixel max on the main thread + canvas.

method: Fresh browser process per run, cold cache, seeded-random interleaved order, 1 s pause between runs.
Times are ms since navigation start (bundle load counts). Drawn = second rAF after the first draw with real data.
Network shaped at the server with one shared token bucket (DevTools emulation may skip worker fetches). JS/HTML/JSON gzipped.
Memory: RSS of the whole browser process tree sampled every 100 ms, minus the same tree idle on a blank page.
CPU: CPU seconds of that tree from navigation to complete, all threads. TBT: Chromium long tasks only.
Accuracy: vs ffmpeg decode (gapless-trimmed), ~20 000 bins aligned to 256-sample reference buckets.
sillon bundle includes React + ReactDOM (~65 kB gz), counted against it.
caveats: One machine, headless browsers, on Battery Power, 1-min load average before each run 4.0 median / 4.7 max; absolute numbers will differ elsewhere.
Speech corpus (TTS); wavesurfer decodes at 8 kHz by default, so its peak accuracy is lower by design and the difference is invisible at overview zoom.
sillon "first bars" is the start of a left-to-right stream, not the whole waveform; compare "complete" or "half" for the full shape.
